choose_device.description: Older versions registered the devices of {name} again at each setup, under a new ID, so {device} exists several times, and Home Assistant cannot tell which one came first. Choose the one to keep: it keeps its name and area, and the entities of the camera are put on it. {current} is the one set up now; if you keep another, it is removed. The others are left as they are.
